correctness.rationale: The complete Xiong v1 construction Sections 2–4 was compared term by term with frozen RESULT.md. Replacing the dyadic Walsh H_k by any normalized Hadamard H preserves pairwise row half-agreement; H_4 tensor H preserves exactly the four special-column counts, so Xiong's four distance cases and scalar equation remain valid. Fresh symbolic calculation gives Phi_4(a)-1=-3(a^2-2)^2/[4(a^4+2)], second a-derivative -2 at sqrt(2), and the claimed p-derivative c=0.0334429143...; 8/c=239.2136022627.... Nondegenerate strict global maximum yields M(4+epsilon)=1+c epsilon+O(epsilon^2). Prime number theorem in the 3 mod 4 progression and Paley q+1 supply Hadamard orders m=(1+o(1))/(c epsilon); continuity solves Phi_p(a)=1+1/m. Thus the matching lower bound is correctly only within this exact template. The frozen p=5,m=44 verifier ran afresh: 352 points in dimension 350 and max relative pairwise discrepancy 4.4e-16, a consistency check rather than the proof.
